messages.text: Morning all. Question on fee schedule exceptions: {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0099}} is asking to get the 85 bps tier on the brokerage account instead of the standard 100 bps. Household is around $1.8M with us. Who signs off on that again?

Anything below the published breakpoint needs a written exception. Grace approves, but the PM usually adds a note on the rationale first. What's the AUM on {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00211}} alone vs the whole household?
Brokerage is about $1.1M, cash mgmt {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00212}} holds roughly $400k, and there's a spouse IRA coming over that would be another $300k. So not yet at the 85 bps breakpoint on paper.
Heads up, I had a similar one last quarter. Compliance wanted the exception documented in ClientHub, not just in email, otherwise it fails the fee audit. Worth doing it right up front.
Good call Tricia. Is there a specific field for it or just a note on the client record?
There's a fee exception activity type in ClientHub. Attach the request, the household AUM projection, and the expiry date. Then PortfolioMgr billing picks up the override once it's approved.
If the IRA transfer is committed, I'd frame it as a conditional exception: 85 bps now, reverts to 100 if household AUM isn't over $2M by end of Q1. James is the RM, so loop him in too.
Makes sense. Will tag James Anderson on the ClientHub entry. The client emailed me at {{CLIENT_EMAIL:c_0099}} confirming the IRA paperwork is in progress, so I'll attach that.

Separate but related: {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0051}} asked about a fee break too. Long-time client, since 2017. I'm thinking we don't need an exception there, they're already on the legacy schedule. Can someone double check?
I can look. Pulling billing for {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00105}} and {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00106}} in PortfolioMgr now.
Confirmed, they're on the grandfathered 80 bps tier already, so nothing to approve. Sandra can just tell them it's already in place. Maybe worth a note in ClientHub so it stops coming up.
Perfect, thanks Janet. I'll ping Sandra and add the note.
Exception request is submitted in ClientHub with the conditional language, the 100 bps reversion trigger, and James tagged. Sent to Grace for approval.
Nice. If Grace asks, tell her I'm fine with the rationale. I'll add my PM note this afternoon.
